reading: A comprehensive police manhunt is underway in Berlin following a grave incident at a recent Pride event.
On Saturday night, an unidentified suspect deliberately rammed a vehicle into a crowd of participants, causing immediate alarm and disruption.
The unknown perpetrator fled the scene promptly after the egregious act, prompting urgent law enforcement mobilisation.
Authorities are currently piecing together the precise timeline of events that began unfolding in the German capital.
The incident occurred amidst festive celebrations for the LGBTQ+ community, tragically marring the occasion.
Security forces have intensified their efforts to apprehend the individual responsible for this targeted assault.
Investigators are examining all available evidence, including witness statements and surveillance footage, to identify the culprit.
The gravity of the situation has prompted increased public vigilance and calls for enhanced security measures at public gatherings.
This shocking act underscores ongoing concerns regarding the safety of public events and the potential for politically or ideologically motivated violence.
The wider community is now awaiting further details from the extensive and ongoing investigation into the incident.

vocabulary.definition: A person who carries out a harmful, illegal, or immoral act.
Outstandingly bad, shocking, or reprehensible, often used to describe severe mistakes or offenses.
Made or become more extreme, severe, or stronger; often referring to efforts, operations, or phenomena.
Emphasizes, highlights, or draws particular attention to a fact, idea, or situation.
covering the main relevant parts of a subject or problem
the process of putting rules or restrictions into effect
covering a large area or involving many parts
causing or encouraging a response or further action
developing or becoming apparent over time

entries.ja: 害になる行為、違法な行為、または不道徳な行為を実行した人。
entries.ko: 해롭거나 불법적이거나 비도덕적인 행위를 저지른 사람.
entries.zh-Hans: 实施有害、非法或不道德行为的人。
entries.es: Una persona que lleva a cabo un acto dañino, ilegal o inmoral.
entries.pt-BR: Uma pessoa que realiza um ato prejudicial, ilegal ou imoral.

entries.ja: 非常に悪い、衝撃的、または非難されるべきで、しばしば重大な間違いや違反を説明する際に用いられる。
entries.ko: 매우 나쁘거나 충격적이거나 비난받을 만한 것으로, 종종 심각한 실수나 위반을 설명할 때 사용됩니다.
entries.zh-Hans: 极其糟糕、令人震惊或应受谴责的，常用于描述严重的错误或罪行。
entries.es: Excepcionalmente malo, impactante o reprensible, a menudo usado para describir errores u ofensas graves.
entries.pt-BR: Extremamente ruim, chocante ou repreensível, frequentemente usado para descrever erros ou ofensas graves.

entries.ja: より極端に、より厳しく、またはより強くされた、あるいはそのようになったこと。努力、作戦、現象などによく使われる。
entries.ko: 더 극심해지거나, 더 심각해지거나, 더 강해진 상태를 의미하며, 노력, 작전, 현상 등에 자주 사용됩니다.
entries.zh-Hans: 使变得或变得更极端、更严重或更强大；常指努力、行动或现象。
entries.es: Hecho o que se ha vuelto más extremo, severo o fuerte; a menudo refiriéndose a esfuerzos, operaciones o fenómenos.
entries.pt-BR: Que se tornou ou foi tornado mais extremo, severo ou forte; frequentemente se referindo a esforços, operações ou fenômenos.

entries.ja: 事実、考え、または状況を強調し、際立たせ、あるいは特に注意を引く。
entries.ko: 어떤 사실, 생각 또는 상황을 강조하거나, 부각시키거나, 특별히 주목하게 하다.
entries.zh-Hans: 强调、突出或特别引起对某个事实、想法或情况的注意。
entries.es: Enfatiza, resalta o llama una atención particular a un hecho, idea o situación.
entries.pt-BR: Enfatiza, destaca ou chama uma atenção particular para um fato, ideia ou situação.

entries.ja: ある主題や問題の主要な関連部分をすべて網羅していること。
entries.ko: 어떤 주제나 문제의 주요 관련 부분을 모두 포함하는.
entries.zh-Hans: 涵盖一个主题或问题的所有主要相关部分。
entries.es: Que cubre todas las partes principales y relevantes de un tema o problema.
entries.pt-BR: Que abrange todas as partes principais e relevantes de um assunto ou problema.

entries.ja: 規則や制限を実際に適用したり実行したりする過程。
entries.ko: 규칙이나 제한을 효과적으로 적용하거나 실행하는 과정.
entries.zh-Hans: 将规则或限制付诸实施的过程。
entries.es: El proceso de poner en práctica reglas o restricciones.
entries.pt-BR: O processo de colocar regras ou restrições em prática.

entries.ja: 広い範囲をカバーしている、または多くの部分を含んでいること。
entries.ko: 넓은 영역을 덮거나 많은 부분을 포함하는.
entries.zh-Hans: 覆盖大面积或涉及许多部分。
entries.es: Que cubre un área grande o involucra muchas partes.
entries.pt-BR: Que cobre uma grande área ou envolve muitas partes.

entries.ja: 応答やさらなる行動を引き起こす、またはそれらを促すこと。
entries.ko: 반응이나 추가적인 행동을 야기하거나 촉진하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 引起或鼓励回应或进一步行动。
entries.es: Causar o fomentar una respuesta o una acción adicional.
entries.pt-BR: Causar ou encorajar uma resposta ou uma ação adicional.

entries.ja: 時間が経つにつれて発展していく、あるいは明らかになっていくこと。
entries.zh-Hans: 随着时间推移而发展或变得明显。
entries.es: Que se desarrolla o se hace evidente con el tiempo.
entries.pt-BR: Que se desenvolve ou se torna aparente com o tempo.

entries.ja: 起こりうる危険に対する注意深い集中。
entries.ko: 닥쳐올 수 있는 위험에 대한 세심한 주의.
entries.zh-Hans: 对可能发生的危险保持警惕。
entries.es: Atención cuidadosa a un posible peligro.
entries.pt-BR: Atenção cuidadosa a um possível perigo.
